description: SandroGT Spider4SPARQL processed dev questions for real_estate_properties. Gold answers are populated from the RDF graph.

questions.nl_question: How many available features are there in total?

questions.gold_sparql: SELECT distinct?col1 WHERE { { select (?t1_property_name as ?col1) where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/properties> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/property_name> ?t1_property_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/property_type_code> ?t1_property_type_code . FILTER(?t1_property_type_code = 'House') . }} UNION {select (?t1_property_name as ?col1) where { ?t1 a <http://valuenet/ontop/properties> . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/property_name> ?t1_property_name . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/property_type_code> ?t1_property_type_code . ?t1 <http://valuenet/ontop/room_count> ?t1_room_count . FILTER(?t1_property_type_code = 'Apartment' && ?t1_room_count > 1) . } } }
questions.nl_question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
